traj_info.agent_final_response:
DIAGNOSIS: Jersey Finger (Avulsion of the Flexor Digitorum Profundus tendon) of the right ring finger.

TREATMENT PLAN:
- Referral to a hand surgeon for surgical repair (reattachment of the FDP tendon to the distal phalanx). Surgery is typically recommended within 7-10 days to prevent tendon retraction and compromised blood supply.
- Splinting the finger in a protective position (dorsal blocking splint) while awaiting surgery.
- Pain management with NSAIDs (e.g., Ibuprofen) and ice elevation.
- Post-operative physical therapy to restore range of motion and strength.

BILLING CODES:
- **ICD-10 Code**: S66.123A (Laceration of flexor muscle, fascia and tendon of right ring finger at wrist and hand level, initial encounter). *Note: Traumatic tendon ruptures/avulsions are often coded under Laceration in ICD-10.*
- **CPT Code**: 26370 (Repair or advancement of profundus tendon, with intact superficialis tendon; primary).
